item.title: would you rather go simplistic or extremely detailed on music making.
item.description:
5.1.26 3:35 am
Q: would you rather go simplistic or extremely detailed on music making.
A: i'm always fantasizing about brutal simplicity. what i aspire to, cherish, and respect, is brutal simplicity. if there ever was any glory in complexity, those days are surely over. and i have very warm feelings about that turn of events, and i am fully on board with the power of simplicity. HOWEVER, my problem is, always, the complexity sneaks in through the side door. every single time. like when a person compulsively bites their fingernails without even realizing it, that's apparently what it's like with me and complexity. there is no glory in complexity but for some strange reason it's surprisingly hard for me to avoid. and the avoidence itself actually starts to become complex
